name: G7 T3 W02 Part 1 - Use spreadsheet formulas
description: Use spreadsheet formulas. 2 words. Required: Flashcards and Matching. Read the Spark with the same name. Use this part in its Technology class.

words.definition: A calculation written in a spreadsheet.
words.example: The formula =B2+B3 adds two cell values.

words.definition: A ready-made calculation, such as SUM, that uses the numbers you give it.
words.example: The function SUM adds the numbers in B2:B5.
